About.description: The About screen: the version and the licences of what the app bundles.

Attachment.description: An attachment of a received message.

save.description: Saves it through the system's file picker.

Banner.description: A problem and the action that may fix it, or news (`info`) with what to do about it.

action.description: The fix, or the main answer.

hint.description: What it probably means and what to do.

info.description: News, not a problem: drawn in neutral colours without the warning sign.

text.description: What went wrong, or the news.

Bulk.description: What can be done with the checked threads.

Button.description: Something to tap: an icon or a text button.

icon.description: The icon's name (`menu`, `back`, `search`, `edit`, `archive`, …), if it has one.

label.description: The label (a tooltip and TalkBack's name for an icon).

Chip.description: An address in a recipient field.

Choice.description: One of the addresses a draft can be sent from.

Class.description: Material's window size classes, by width.

oneOf.description: 600–839 dp: the list and the detail.
840 dp and wider: the drawer, the list and the detail.

Composer.description: The open draft, editable unless a send is scheduled or under way.

actions.description: *Attach files* (`pick_files`) and *Discard*, while the draft is editable.

body.description: The body (the quote stays below it).

editable.description: Whether the fields take typing (not while a send is scheduled or leaving).

from_choices.description: The account's addresses, with two or more (a menu on `from`).

problems.description: What went wrong: a failed send (with its hint), a failed save.

quote.description: The original, for a reply or a forward.

DocBlock.description: A block of a message body (`app_core::document::Block`, cleaned, with action IDs).

oneOf.description: A run of text; `\n` in a span is a line break.

items.description: The items, each a list of blocks.

oneOf.description: Monospace text with its spacing kept, line by line.

rows.description: The rows, each a list of cells.

oneOf.description: Quoted earlier messages or a signature, folded until tapped.

hit.description: A search word, while a search is open.

image.description:
A picture of the message, shown in place of `text` (its alt text) while the sender's
pictures show.

link.description: A link: a tap shows its full target first (the text may say something else).

all_inboxes.description: Every account's inbox, with two accounts or more.

modal.description:
A modal drawer over the panes of `layout` (compact and medium windows); otherwise it is
the first pane.

rail.description: A navigation rail (icons only) rather than the full drawer (`toggle_sidebar`).

style.description:
Switches between the rail and the full tree (`toggle_sidebar`), where the pane can be
either: a landscape window that is not compact, or an expanded one (MISC-11).

fold.description: The chevron that folds the whole account (`collapse_folders` with an empty path).

mailboxes.description:
Its folders as the sidebar's tree shows them: in tree order, without the folders below
a collapsed one, and none while the account is collapsed (MISC-10).

tag.description: Its colour: an index into the theme's `tags`, with two accounts or more.

action.description: Opens it; for a folder the server does not let us open, the same as `fold`'s action.

depth.description: Its level in the folder tree, `0` at the top (indent by it).

fold.description: The chevron, if folders hang below it.

Field.description: A text field of the composer.

oneOf.description:
Account setup: the password. It never comes back in a frame: the presenter moves it
into a `Secret` for the keyring.

Fold.description: The chevron of a folder that has folders below it, or of an account.

collapsed.description: Whether the folders below are hidden (the chevron points right).

FrameTheme.description: A theme, sent in the frame when it changes (the settings or the system's dark mode).

chrome.description: The chrome group's roles (top bar, drawer); equal to `content` in a flat theme.

content.description: The content group's colour roles (`base`, `text`, …) as `#RRGGBBAA`.

dark.description: Whether it is dark (the status bar's icons, Material's dark scheme).

icons.description: The icon font's glyph for each icon name the frames use (`archive` → `"\u{e149}"`).

metrics.description: Spacing, radii, strokes and sizes in dp, as `app_theme::Metrics`.

type_scale.description: The type scale by token name (`body_md`, …).

ImagesBar.description: The pictures of a message body.

text.description: `Pictures in this message are hidden.`, or that they show.

InlineImage.description: A picture carried in the message (`cid:`), drawn from the body's blob.

InputKind.description: The kind of a setup field: chooses the keyboard and the autofill hints.

oneOf.description: An email address (autofill: email address, username).

Layout.description: The window class and the panes, left to right.

panes.description: The panes on screen, left to right.

Licence.description: A bundled work and its licence.

LinkSheet.description: A link's full target, before it opens.

open.description: *Open* in the browser (a `mailto:` link opens a new draft instead).

List.description: The thread list: a window of rows around the visible ones.

checked.description: Checked threads (a bulk bar shows while any are).

empty.description: What to say when the list is empty.

offset.description: The index of `rows[0]`; rows outside the window are placeholders.

refreshing.description: A sync is running (pull to refresh shows its spinner).

server.description: The server search's state, while a search is open: running, or its last failure.

total.description: Rows in the whole list (`LazyColumn`'s item count).

MessageId.description: One message copy, i.e. one `(mailbox, uid)` pair.

OutgoingFile.description: A file attached to the open draft.

detail.description: `checking…`, the size, or why it cannot be sent.

failed.description: Whether the check failed (the draft cannot be sent with it).

remove.description: Removes it from the draft, while the draft is editable.

detail.description: The second label (a category, an account, the senders).

keys.description: The key binding, for a hardware keyboard.

PaletteSection.description: Rows of the palette under one caption.

title.description: The caption (`Recent`, `Mail`, `Mailboxes`, …); empty for a ranked list.

PaletteSheet.description:
The command palette: the registry's commands, mailboxes and recent threads, then the
second steps of `app_front::palette`.

close.description: Leaves the step, else closes the palette.

prompt.description: The second step's question (`Move to which mailbox?`), if in one.

query.description: The typed text (`text` events name the `query` field).

sections.description: The rows, under captions (one untitled section with a query or in a step).

hit.description: Whether it is a search word.

PresetChoice.description: A provider to choose in the first step.

hint.description: What it needs (`Needs an App Password`).

Preview.description:
A received attachment, shown in the app. There is no "open with": other apps get it only
through *Save*.

detail.description: The MIME type and the size.

note.description: What to say instead of the content (no preview for this type).

PreviewKind.description: How an attachment is shown in the app.

oneOf.description: Decoded by the host (`blob`'s `image` request: width, height, RGBA).
Cleaned text from the host (`blob`'s `text` request: UTF-8).
Not shown; it can be saved.

QuoteFold.description: The original below a reply or a forward: read-only, folded until tapped.

header.description: The attribution or the forward header, line by line, while expanded.

label.description: What the folded quote says (`Quoted message`, `Forwarded message`).

actions.description: What can be done with it: archive, trash, star, read, *Move…*, reply.

close.description:
The × next to the subject: closes the message (`close_thread`), leaving the list
(MISC-7).

maximize.description:
Beside the ×: maximizes the message (no sidebar, no list, a bare top bar), or restores
the panes. Only while there is something to hide or it is maximized (MISC-14).

next.description: The conversation below it in the list, if any: a swipe to the left (MISC-5; no button).

position.description: Where it is in the list (`2 of 14`); not drawn since the pager went (MISC-5).

previous.description: The conversation above it in the list, if any: a swipe to the right (MISC-5; no button).

ReaderMessage.description: A message of the open thread.

body.description:
The body as blocks, once downloaded (expanded messages only): an HTML body's document,
or the plain text's paragraphs with its signature and quote folded.

images.description:
Whether the body's own pictures show, and the button that changes it for the sender,
when the body has any (`show_images_from`; nothing remote ever loads).

links.description: *Links (N)*: every link target in the body, in full; a tap shows it before it opens.

save_all.description: *Save all*, with two attachments or more.

snippet.description: The start of the text, for a collapsed message.

status.description: Why the body is missing (`Loading…`, a download error).

field.description: Which field (`text` and `blur` events name it).

input.description: What is typed and not yet an address.

suggestions.description: Contacts matching the typed text; a tap adds one.

ResultView.description: A query's result as text, read-only. Email content in it is untrusted data.

lines.description: The result (pretty JSON), line by line.

note.description: Says that it is read-only and untrusted.

action.description: A tap opens it (checks or unchecks it while threads are checked).

marks.description: The search words in the subject and the snippet, while a search is open.

pinned.description: Whether it is pinned to the top (MISC-4).

selected.description: Whether it is the open or selected thread.

snippet.description: The start of the newest message.

swipe_end.description: Swiped towards the end edge: trash.

swipe_start.description: Swiped towards the start edge: archive.

tag.description: Its account's colour (an index into the theme's `tags`), with two accounts or more.

RowMarks.description: A row's subject and snippet, cut where the search words are.

SettingRow.description: One setting, an account or a link.

choices.description: The values to choose from (segmented buttons; the current one selected). A tap sets it.

label.description: What it is (`Undo send`, an account's address).

value.description: Its current value or state, as text.

SettingsGroup.description: Rows of the settings page under one caption.

hint.description: What the group is about, if it needs saying.

SettingsPage.description: The settings page: the sections as tabs, and the open one's rows in groups.

groups.description: The open section's rows, under captions.

tabs.description: The sections; a tap opens one (`open_settings`).

SetupField.description: A text field of the account setup.

input.description: The keyboard and the autofill hints.

value.description:
Its text. Always empty for the password, whose `version` changes when the host must
clear it.

SetupSheet.description:
The account setup (over the panes; Back goes a step back, then closes it): provider →
address → password → test → sync, like the desktop's wizard. Also the password form of an
existing account.

actions.description: The step's buttons, the main one last (*Next*, *Add and test*, *Sync now*, …).

busy.description: Whether it waits for the server (a spinner).

error.description: What is wrong (an invalid address, a failed login).

fields.description: The text fields of the step.

note.description: A line to read (where the password goes, what *Find servers* found, the test's result).

presets.description: The providers, in the first step.

step.description: The step (`2 / 4  Address`, or the account's address).

Snackbar.description: A short message at the bottom.

TextValue.description:
A text field's content. The host reloads its field only when `version` changes, so a frame
never overwrites what the IME is composing.

version.description:
Changes whenever the presenter replaces the text (another draft, an edit from elsewhere,
addresses taken from the typed text).

ThreadId.description: A conversation that groups messages across mailboxes.

navigation.description: The navigation button: the drawer, or back.

about.description: The About screen, while open (over everything else; Back closes it).

back.description: Whether system Back is taken (send `back`); otherwise Android handles it.

banner.description:
A problem to fix (a failed login, a failed sync), else news: a new version of dail, or
the question whether to check for one.

bulk.description: The bulk bar, while threads are checked (in place of the top bar's actions).

composer.description: The open draft, while on screen.

drawer.description: Accounts and mailboxes, while on screen.

layout.description: The window class and the panes on screen.

link.description: A tapped link's full target, before it opens (a sheet; Back closes it).

list.description: The thread list, while on screen.

palette.description:
The command palette, while open (a sheet over the panes; Back leaves its step, then
closes it).

preview.description: A received attachment shown in the app (over the panes; Back closes it).

reader.description: The open thread, while on screen.

result.description: A query's result, while open (over the panes; Back closes it).

revision.description: Counts the frames this presenter made.

setup.description: The account setup, while open (over the panes).

snackbar.description: A short message: a send counting down, an undoable action, a rejection.

theme.description:
The theme, in the first frame and whenever it changes (the settings, the system's dark
mode); the host keeps the last one.

wants_tick.description: Whether to send `tick` every second (a countdown or an age is shown).
